Pilot reference

Own the sky.

Steer: left stick / WASDMove within the flight corridor.
Fire: ✕ / SpaceHold to fire. Keep a target near the reticle to lock; homing volleys fire automatically.
Roll: L1 · R1 / Q · EBrief invulnerability; reflects nearby shots. Costs energy.
Speed: R2 / Shift · L2 / CtrlBoost to cross danger quickly; brake to line up targets. Energy recharges.
Bomb: ○ / BClears incoming fire and heavily damages all visible hostiles.
Wingmate: △ / CCall Kite for a strike. Recharges over 18 seconds.
Gold rings / cyan suppliesRings repair shields; three upgrade your guns. Supplies add a bomb.
Vesper carrierDestroy both amber shield emitters; then hit the exposed red core. Dodge the cannon lanes.
